title: Standalone dense dual encoders
input: Give exactly one original paper whose primary contribution is a trained dense dual-encoder passage retriever for open-domain question answering. Exclude retrieval-augmented generators, downstream readers, and benchmark-only studies.
constraints: 只根据本题授权论文原文判断本篇贡献，缺失证据不凭背景提及补全。
expected_output: 相关论文完整文件名和有原文依据的理由；无匹配可为空。
